description: A button that adds one module to the rack, picked at random from every plugin installed
notes: the die face is the only control. Clicking it picks a model at random from the whole installed library and drops it into the rack beside the mouse, with its default preset loaded.
the addition goes onto the undo stack, so it can be undone like any other.
the button is drawn as a plain widget rather than as a parameter, so a click on it cannot reach this help.
there are no jacks. Nothing here processes audio or CV.
